business_problem: CCTV.com needed a better way to surface the value of its huge video archive because title- and keyword-based retrieval could not expose enough scene-level meaning, leaving many useful videos hard to find.
solution_summary: CCTV.com and Baidu AI Cloud built the 'AI Helps You Find' intelligent search system using speech recognition and multimodal media-retrieval capabilities. Instead of depending only on titles, descriptions, and manually assigned keywords, the system analyzes video content with face recognition, OCR, natural-language processing, and knowledge-graph techniques to extract many dimensions of tags from the media itself. Those tags then drive more expressive search and recommendation behaviors, letting users query from multiple angles and still find relevant content. Voice input is layered on top so users can issue commands without typing and receive results quickly. The result is an AI media-search architecture in which speech input, multimodal understanding, and tag-driven retrieval work together to unlock previously 'cold' assets in CCTV.com's archive and turn a large media catalog into a more accessible interactive knowledge surface for audiences.

solution_components.name: Real-Time Speech Recognition
solution_components.role: Provides voice-command input for the intelligent media-search experience.

solution_components.name: Multimodal Media Retrieval
solution_components.role: Indexes video resources with AI-generated tags and retrieves results across multiple semantic dimensions.

data_flow: Users issue spoken or typed requests into the search system, which maps them against AI-generated video tags derived from faces, text, language, and knowledge-graph relationships. Matching results are then returned as search and recommendation outputs that help users locate relevant clips quickly.
business_outcome: CCTV.com made its video catalog easier to search, improved retrieval efficiency, and gave users a more natural voice- and semantics-driven way to discover media assets.
architecture_clues: The search system fuses face recognition, OCR, NLP, and knowledge graphs to tag videos across many dimensions
Voice commands were added as a first-class interaction layer
The goal was to unlock value from otherwise hard-to-find archived videos
evidence_quotes: CCTV.com and Baidu AI Cloud built the 'AI Helps You Find' intelligent search system, and resource retrieval efficiency improved 90% (original: 央视网联合百度智能云打造“AI帮你找”智能搜索系统…资源检索效率提升90%).

Traditional video search based on titles, descriptions, and keywords cannot expose all value points in the video, leaving many assets effectively 'frozen' (original: 传统的视频搜索中，用户主要是通过视频标题、简介、关键词等内容，对视频进行搜索…很多视频因此处于被『冷藏』的状态).

The system combines face recognition, text recognition, natural-language processing, and knowledge graphs to extract tags from multiple dimensions of the video (original: 将人脸识别、文字识别、自然语言处理、知识图谱等人工智能技术进行综合…形成不同类型的视频标签).
Voice input gives users a more convenient command experience and makes it possible to request programs by speaking rather than typing (original: 『语音输入』为用户提供了更便捷的指令发送方式，『动嘴不动手』的节目点播体验).
